notes.title: You can now play the Paradox demo as part of the Steam Next Fest
notes.notes:
Hey time traveler,

You can finally boot up your time machine and travel to Paradox!, our puzzle adventure! Buckle up in multiplace time-spaces as your past and future selves must team up to face arduous platformer levels with quick thinking, excellent time management and a little luck, from time to time.

Inspired by classic Cartoon Network vibes, and reminiscent of titles such as Pizza Tower and Cuphead, you'll play each level twice, once as your younger self, then as your future self, helping your past self succeed in what we describe as a solo-player co-op! But beware: if your two selves touch, you're out of the timeline for good.

This is a great game for casual fans of the genre, but it won’t always be an easy ride. Experienced players, get ready to showcase your speed running results with us!

The demo is live now and will be during the Steam Next Fest, give it a go and share your feedback at [url=https://forms.gle/PC6S4xNf1xTjU9Qq9]this link[/url].

Thank you,

Rewind Studios

notes.title: Discover Paradox! Our Time-Bending Mission to Save Time, with a February Demo!
notes.notes:
Hello time traveler, 

Whether you’re reading this today, tomorrow, or yesterday, we’re Rewind Studios, and we’re super pleased to introduce you to our debut game, Paradox!

Imagine a world where every level you play is a dance between your past and future selves. That's what we've created with Paradox!, a form of solo-player co-op inspired by the beloved art style of those classic Cartoon Network shows from the late 90s and early noughties. 

We’ve tried to bring that nostalgic vibe into a fresh, mind-bending puzzle-platformer that’ll have you try, try and try again until each level is surpassed, and your time machine fixed.

In Paradox! you start as a young, sprightly professor with a broken time machine, racing against time to gather scattered time crystals. The levels are filled with challenges, think deadly lasers and disappearing platforms,  but here's the twist: you play each level twice. First, as your younger self, then you switch to your future self. In the future, you're not just playing the same exact level again; you're essentially playing co-op with your past self, manipulating the environment to help your younger version succeed. But remember, if your two selves bump into each other, poof, you're out of the timeline!

We've poured our love for sci-fi, time travel conundrums, and the quirky humor of early internet culture into this game. It’s not just about solving puzzles; it's about thinking like a time traveler, where every action you take in the past directly shapes your future.

You're thus invited to wishlist Paradox! on Steam right now, and to mark your calendars, as a public demo will be available starting February 20th and throughout the Steam Next Fest. 

  - Rewind Studios
